purpose: Compare a Tripo-generated head/body appearance candidate with the Blender v01 model; not a replacement gameplay rig

image_generation.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: single clean reference image for Tripo image-to-3D, HEAD AND BODY APPEARANCE STUDY of Wankai's beagle fighter. Input image 1 is the user's cartoon identity reference collage; select the plain sleepy half-lidded beagle look. Produce exactly ONE complete character alone, not a collage. Translate its appeal into a polished simple matte 3D vinyl-toy game character. Warm caramel tan large rounded rectangular head, centered soft white forehead blaze joining a small white muzzle/chin, enormous dark half-lidded eyes with an unimpressed slightly smug expression, tiny black oval nose, restrained curved smirk. Tiny soft white rounded torso with two short tucked front paws held slightly away from sides, two small white feet, short tan tail with white end subtly visible at side. Restrained plain terracotta triangular neck bib. Soft smoothly modeled cheek and eyelid volumes, crisp clean white/tan color boundaries, tactile matte surface, no fur strands, no realism, no glossy plastic. The head is about 60 percent of standing height. Two broad flat tan rounded paddle-shaped beagle ears hang at the sides, long enough to frame the head down to the feet, clearly separated from torso and face with small negative gaps; obvious small roots on upper sides of head. These ears are placeholder shape references only: do not create weapons, blades or mechanical hardware. Main priority the attractive sleepy cartoon face and tiny body faithful to the supplied collage. Symmetrical neutral front standing pose, eye-level near-orthographic view with only a very slight three-quarter angle to show muzzle depth; both eyes both paws and both ears completely visible. One character centered filling canvas with ample margin; transparent background. Even neutral studio illumination, no harsh shadows, no pedestal, no ground plane, no labels, no letters, no watermark, no props, no extra animals, no accessories beyond bib, no clothing. Do not reproduce the collage UI or surrounding examples.
